(2) The camera pans or zooms out slightly to reveal a toddler sitting on a gray sofa in the background, wearing a white onesie and a blue bib. (3) The young man moves closer to the toddler, and both faces are centered in the frame. The man's facial features appear exaggerated, possibly by an AI filter, as he looks curiously at the child. (4) A pink comic-style explosion graphic appears behind the man as he makes a stern facial expression. (5) The man puckers his lips in a kissing gesture while looking at the toddler, who maintains a neutral, slightly confused expression. (6) The scene shifts to an older man with graying hair sitting on the same sofa next to the toddler, speaking directly to the camera. (7) The toddler's face is replaced by an elderly man's face using a highly realistic AI filter, while keeping the child's small body and clothes. (8) The young man (now without the old filter) and the 'elderly toddler' laugh together, looking into the camera. (9) The 'elderly toddler' waves a hand towards the camera while smiling, showing wrinkles and white hair under the filter. (10) The filter is removed at the very end as the toddler kisses the young man's cheek, returning to his natural appearance.
